assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to assess the efficacy of current management strategies
The service directly addresses the documented clinical indication of recurrent palpitations requiring telemetry correlation
